🛑 ALERT - Node2Shell RCE exploit works on an official Node.js build.

Researchers demonstrated how crafted Brotli data can trigger code execution through vulnerable Node.js applications, without modifying the runtime.

Here's how the exploit works: https://t.co/ffJvHDqRXj https://t.co/sLH83S7p9r
